text:
Maya: Quick q — launch is next Wed. Do we keep the normal weekly newsletter that week or pause and send a focused launch sequence + re-engage drip for sleepers? Need a decision by EOD so ops can schedule.
Sam: i'd lean pause the broad weekly. send: launch announcement, follow-up tutorial, and a product deep-dive. fewer sends to top-of-funnel. :+1:
Priya: +1 to pausing. also we should prune/snooze inactive subs before launch to keep engagement metrics clean. propose: snooze if opens < 2 in 90d, then run a 2-email re-engage, prune after 180d no opens+no clicks.
Evan: ok — curious about numbers. what size is the "snooze" segment vs prune? we need to estimate deliverability impact.
Maya: current raw newsletter list ~ 320k. Opens in last 90d = ~95k. So snooze segment would be ~225k. After 2 re-engage sends we expect ~5–10% reactivation. good to prune the long tail pre-launch.
Priya: re-engage cadence proposal: day0 = "We miss you — what's new at Redwood"; day3 = "New low-latency benchmarks + 3 tips"; day10 = "Last chance: customize your digest". if still inactive => move to `pruned` suppression list. A/B subject test on the first re-engage: A = "We miss you — update from Redwood" vs B = "New benchmarks + low-latency tips".
Sam: add a send-time A/B as well: 10am PST vs 4pm PST. track opens by timezone bucket.
Priya: segment SQL snapshot for ops (small sample):
```sql
SELECT user_id, email
FROM newsletter_subscribers
WHERE status = 'subscribed'
  AND last_open_at < now() - interval '90 days'
  AND (last_click_at IS NULL OR last_click_at < now() - interval '90 days');
```
Maya: important: exclude customers & trial users signed up in last 365d and anyone with `snooze_opt_out=true`. Also exclude people in the upcoming webinar invite list.
Evan: will engineering run the actual export? I can schedule the job. what's the cutoff for the "pruned" tag? we said 180d after re-engage?
Priya: yes — after the 2nd re-engage + 180d inactivity -> add tag `pruned_2026_launch_sweep`. ops should write that to MailProvider suppression list.
Sam: action items:
- Priya: finalize subject lines + creative by tomorrow noon.
- Maya: confirm final send windows and calendar slots, update the launch week cadence doc.
- Evan: run export & create suppression list CSV, deliver by EOD tomorrow.
- Ops: schedule 3 launch emails + 2 re-engage emails, with A/B tests wired.
Maya: one more thing — we should surface expected open-rate uplift to execs if we prune ~200k inert subs (estimate uplift 2–3pp). I'll draft the slide.
marketing-bot: Campaign "launch-week-2026" created in Campaign Manager (id: cm_2026_03_14) — scheduled sends pending final assets.
Priya: thanks — I'll drop subject lines and the A/B matrix in the doc, ping when done. :raised_hands:
Maya: perfect. if no objections by EOD we'll proceed with the plan.
Sam: no objections from me.
Evan: ok, starting the export now.
